info.name: Naamaty — تطبيق الجمعيات
info.description:
Everything the charity app needs, and nothing else — the donor and admin
endpoints live in the separate FoodSurplus collection.

=== SETUP ===
1. Set `base_url` if the API is not on http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1
2. Run "إنشاء حساب جمعية" or "تسجيل الدخول" — the token is stored in
   `charity_token` automatically and every other request just works.
3. A brand new charity is `pending`. An admin must approve it before any
   charity endpoint answers; until then they all return 403.

=== RESPONSE SHAPE ===
Every response, success or failure, looks like this:
{ "success": bool, "data": object|null, "message": string|null, "errors": object|null }

So one handler covers the whole app:
- success == true  -> read `data`
- success == false -> show `message`, and on 422 show `errors` under each field

Messages are already in Arabic and can be displayed as they arrive.

Status codes: 200 OK · 201 Created · 401 Unauthenticated · 403 Forbidden ·
404 Not found · 422 Validation error · 429 Too many requests.

=== THE WORKFLOW ===
pending    الطلب منشور، ظاهر في الطلبات المتاحة
  -> قبول الطلب
accepted   الجمعية أخذته، charity_id و accepted_at و eta_minutes مضبوطة
  -> تأكيد الأخذ من الطرفين
picked_up  الطعام انتقل فعلاً
  -> تأكيد التوزيع
completed  انتهى الطلب. أرقام المستفيدين اختيارية ويمكن إدخالها لاحقاً.

THE HANDOVER NEEDS BOTH SIDES. تأكيد الأخذ is only the charity's half; the
donor presses its own button. The status changes only once both have confirmed,
which is what stops either side from claiming a pickup that never happened.
While you are waiting, the status stays "accepted" and the message tells you so.

Other statuses you may see, all set by the system, never by this app:
  expired   انتهت صلاحيته قبل أن تقبله جمعية
  cancelled ألغاه المتبرع
  no_show   قبلته جمعية ولم تحضر

=== PAGINATION ===
Rows      -> data.data
Page info -> data.meta   (current_page, last_page, per_page, total)
Page URLs -> data.links
Next page -> add ?page=2

=== HEADS UP ===
register and login share a limit of 5 requests per minute per IP. Going over
returns 429 "محاولات كثيرة جداً". Nothing is broken — wait a minute.

request.description:
Creates the charity account. It always starts as status = "pending" and stays
unusable until an admin approves it — every charity endpoint answers 403
"حساب الجمعية غير مفعّل بعد" until then. A pending charity CAN log in and call
/me, so the app can show a "waiting for approval" screen.

FIELDS
- name        : max 120
- email       : must not already exist as a donor OR a charity
- phone       : max 20
- password    : min 8, plus password_confirmation
- has_kitchen : true|false. false means this charity is never shown food that
                needs cooking.
- address     : max 255
- work_start / work_end : "HH:MM", end after start
- license_document : optional FILE (pdf/jpg/png, max 5MB)

ATTACHING THE LICENCE
Send the whole request as multipart/form-data and add license_document as a
file. Without a file, plain JSON works too.

Returns a token that is usable immediately for /me and /logout.

request.description:
Screen 1 — الطلبات المتاحة.

Open requests this charity may take. Already filtered for you:
- only status "pending", and not past valid_until
- if the charity has no kitchen, food that needs cooking is hidden
- a request this charity previously no-showed on never reappears

CARD FIELDS
- title            : the food category, in Arabic
- description      : the donor's note, or the quantity when there is no note
- image_url        : first photo, null when the donor uploaded none
- images           : every photo
- category_icon    : stable key for your own asset ("cooked_ready", ...)
- expiry_date      : "YYYY-MM-DD"
- pickup_deadline  : ready to print, e.g. "05:00 مساءً"
- location_zone    : the pickup address as the donor typed it
- latitude/longitude : map pin, null when the donor skipped it
- *_iso fields     : raw timestamps for sorting or countdowns

The donor's phone number is deliberately NOT here — it appears once you accept.
Paginated 15 per page; rows in data.data.

request.description:
Screen 1 -> Screen 2. Claims the request and moves it pending -> accepted.

eta_minutes: how long you need to arrive, 5 to 480.

Two charities can press this at the same time; only the first wins and the
other gets 422 "لم يعد هذا الطلب متاحاً". Other 422 reasons: the request
expired, or it needs cooking and your charity has no kitchen.

Accepting notifies the donor which charity is coming and when.

request.description:
Screen 2, step 2 — تأكيد الأخذ.

THE HANDOVER NEEDS BOTH SIDES. This is only the charity's half; the donor
presses its own button separately. The request reaches "picked_up" ONLY once
both have confirmed, so neither side can record a handover the other never
agreed to.

WHAT YOU GET BACK
- still waiting on the donor -> status stays "accepted",
  message "تم تسجيل تأكيدك، بانتظار تأكيد المتبرع"
- the donor already confirmed -> status becomes "picked_up",
  message "تم تأكيد استلام الطعام"

Read data.donor_confirmed_at / data.charity_confirmed_at to draw the timeline.
Pressing twice returns 422.
